prompt:
Build from scratch a fully interactive, cinematic, stylized 3D scene of a grand Chinese junk sailing through a misty karst bay at dawn. Make it as detailed and high-quality as possible.

SCENE
- A calm, jade-green bay surrounded by tall limestone karst towers (Ha Long Bay / Guilin style): sheer fluted cliffs, ledges, tidal notches at the waterline, vegetation clinging to slopes and summits, layered ranks fading into morning mist.
- Dawn light: low warm sun behind the sails, soft pink-gold sky with clouds, cool blue mist in the distance, light shafts, height fog.
- Water: gentle waves, mirror-like reflections of the cliffs and ships, cat's-paw ripple patches, sun glitter, lantern glints, white foam at the bow and a lacy V-shaped wake behind every ship.

HERO SHIP
- A large five-masted junk (~45 m) with red battened sails: fan-shaped, curved leeches, bamboo battens, parrels, sheetlets fanning to the euphroes, lazy jacks, four-part halyard tackles, wear and patched panels, natural cloth flutter in the wind.
- Hull: raked transoms, high stern, bow horns, painted sheer strakes in red and jade, a painted eye on the bow, wales, gold studs, fenders, a large rudder and tiller, a painted ornamental stern board with carved gilded cloud scrolls.
- Gilded carving: dragon heads rearing from the bow horns (open jaws, antler horns, whiskers, flame mane); a long relief dragon with dorsal spines and clawed legs writhing along the upper hull towards the eye.
- Lacquered round shields with gold petal wreaths hung along the bulwarks, bronze swivel guns on the rail.
- Deck: cabins with lattice windows and glowing paper lanterns, woven mat roofs, a helm pavilion on the poop with red columns and a sweeping jade-tiled roof with upturned eaves, a windlass, anchors, hatches, crates, jars, straw rice sacks, barrels, rope coils, a yuloh scull.
- Rigging dressed with strings of paper lanterns and small colored pennants between the mast trucks, long streamers flying from the mastheads, a rope ladder up the mainmast.
- Crew of 12+ posed sailors in conical straw hats, headbands and caps: hauling a halyard, steering, the captain with hands behind his back, two drinking tea, sculling, carrying a sack, coiling rope, a lookout shading his eyes, one climbing the mast.

SURROUNDINGS
- A convoy of 5–6 smaller junks with different sail dyes (red, ochre, oxblood), each with its own wake.
- Pagodas on small rocky islets drifting past with the cliffs.
- Hundreds of floating lotus lanterns, bamboo rafts with fishermen and cormorants, flocks of white egrets, thin galley smoke.

CAMERA & IMAGE
- Slow cinematic auto-orbit with low water-skimming passes, wide shots of the whole fleet and close passes along the hull showing the carvings and crew.
- Mouse drag to orbit, wheel/pinch to zoom, double-click or a few seconds idle returns to the auto camera.
- Depth of field focused on the ship (background softens on close-ups), bloom, ACES tone mapping, color grade, vignette, subtle grain, soft shadows.
- The ship gently heaves, pitches and rolls with the waves; nothing in slow motion.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
- No text of any kind may appear anywhere inside the scene: no titles, names, logos, descriptions, credits, labels, characters or control instructions in any language.
- Deliver the entire project as one final standalone HTML file that opens directly in a web browser, with all assets (textures, geometry, code) generated procedurally or embedded inside it. No external requests.
- No primitive placeholder shapes in the finished result. Lighting must reveal the geometry.
- Balance visual quality and real-time performance: level of detail for distant ships, adaptive resolution if the frame rate drops.
- Actually test the finished result in a desktop web browser: capture screenshots from many angles, inspect the console for errors and warnings, and fix every visible or technical issue. Verify the final file opens directly, has no text, and has no runtime errors.
- Then finish the task with only a brief response.
